# Blue Collar Tips

> Recognition and tipping platform for any field service employee — the feedback loop that turns good work into more tips.

Blue Collar Tips helps field service employees (towing, HVAC, plumbing, landscaping, cleaning, delivery, install/repair, and more) get recognized more often for doing good work. Company-supported and technology-leveraged: a branded page delivered by QR code or text link captures a rating, feedback, and a tip in one tap. The feedback gets you the tip — more often, and with higher payouts.
